headlines.title: More Money, Fewer Checks: These 3 Charts Show The Divide Behind VC’s Record Funding Year
headlines.excerpt: Record venture funding in 2026 has been increasingly concentrated in massive AI rounds, while seed- and early-stage deal counts are on the decline. Using Crunchbase data we provide a look at how third-quarter funding continued the year's dollars-up-but-deals-down trend.

headlines.title: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Physical AI And Predictions Lead The Lineup
headlines.excerpt: This week featured a robust lineup of large rounds, led by manufacturing startup Re:Build, which closed on $2.1 billion, and predictions marketplace Kalshi, which picked up another $1 billion.

headlines.title: Sector Snapshot: Travel Tech Funding Heads Toward Multiyear Low Despite AI Push
headlines.excerpt: Travel demand appears to be holding up, but at the same time, investor appetite for travel tech startups has cooled. Even a wave of startups promising to improve travel with AI hasn’t managed to reverse the funding slowdown. We share what a review of Crunchbase data shows.

headlines.title: Series B Funding Is Up, But Fewer Deals Are Getting Done
headlines.excerpt: Crunchbase data shows that so far this year, investors have poured around $48 billion into financings around the Series B stage, the highest tally in years. Yet round counts are below year-ago levels and are on track for a multiyear low. We take a look at the data.

headlines.title: Jumbo Series A Rounds Hiding The Real Squeeze On Seed Startups
headlines.excerpt: AI megarounds are masking a shrinking Series A market, leaving seed founders facing higher revenue expectations and longer timelines despite larger seed checks. To improve their chances, MGV's Marc Schröder says, founders should size their seed funding around Series A milestones.
